reasons: Prerequisites for CS4239 (CS3235) cannot be completed by Y3S1 (Sem 5) given the current progress and prerequisites for CS3235.

CS4226 requires EE2012A/EE2012/ST2334/ESP2107 and MA2116/ST2131/ST2334/MA2116T/MA2116. CS4238 requires CS3235. CS3235 requires CS2105/EE3204/EE4204 AND CS2106/YSC3217/CG2271 AND CS2107. Completing this chain by Sem 5 is impossible as CS2106/CG2271 require CS2040/CS2040S/CS2040C/CS2040DE/CS2040HS which require CS1010 variants, and CS2105 requires CS2040 variants. Even with optimal planning, CS2040 is typically taken in Y1S2 or Y2S1, making CS2105/CS2106 available in Y2S2/Y3S1, pushing CS3235 to Y3S2 or later, thus CS4238/CS4239 cannot be in Y3S1 as requested.
